item.name: Negative
item.description: Invalid, missing, and malformed authentication scenarios.

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-001. Uses a request-local invalid password and does not modify valid runtime tokens.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: invalid password returns observed status 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Characterization: invalid credentials response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics indicate invalid credentials', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/invalid.*credentials/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.any.keys('accessToken', 'refreshToken'); });

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-002. Omits username independently and does not modify runtime tokens.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: missing username returns observed status 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Characterization: missing username response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics identify required credentials', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/username/i).and.match(/password/i).and.match(/required/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.any.keys('accessToken', 'refreshToken'); });

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-003. Omits password independently and does not modify runtime tokens.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: missing password returns observed status 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Characterization: missing password response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics identify required credentials', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/username/i).and.match(/password/i).and.match(/required/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.any.keys('accessToken', 'refreshToken'); });

item.name: AUTH-007 Protected endpoint handles missing access token

header.description: Explicitly overrides Newman cookie-jar auth so this request truly has no access token.

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-004. Explicitly disables authorization so a valid collection token cannot leak into this request.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: missing access token returns observed status 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('Characterization: missing-token response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics require an access token', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/access.*token/i).and.match(/required/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.property('id'); });

item.name: AUTH-008 Protected endpoint handles malformed bearer token

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-005. Uses a request-local malformed Bearer value and never reads or overwrites valid runtime tokens.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: malformed bearer token returns observed status 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('Characterization: malformed-token response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics identify an invalid or expired token', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/invalid|expired/i).and.match(/token/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.property('id'); });

item.name: AUTH-009 Refresh handles invalid refresh token

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-006. Uses a request-local invalid refresh value and does not overwrite valid collection tokens.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: invalid refresh token returns observed status 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

pm.test('Characterization: invalid-refresh response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics identify an invalid refresh token', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/invalid/i).and.match(/refresh/i).and.match(/token/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.any.keys('accessToken', 'refreshToken'); });
